verdict: A hard week — Meta went dark and Google spend produced no verified leads.
narrative: This period delivered 128 leads at a cost of $22.23 each, but the last seven days drove that number: lead volume fell 48% week-over-week while cost per lead rose 63%, meaning efficiency broke rather than simply softened. Meta went fully dark on August 15–16, cutting off a channel that had been consistently producing 4–15 leads on active days. At the same time, Google Ads ran $1,495 in spend across the 28-day window with zero recorded conversions — the top campaign alone accounted for $1,172 of that with nothing attributable. Meta is being restored and monitored as the immediate priority, and Google's search campaign is being audited this week to identify why clicks are not converting before further spend runs.
